claim_ceiling: FALSIFIES is justified ONLY under frozen spec decision_rule that treats ANY orthogonality break and ANY None threshold (including degenerate 100% identical distributions) as global falsification. Maximum justified scientific claim: Freshness guard DOES discriminate under genuine Gaussian overlap in bounded regime 0-25% (threshold 0.20->0.25 monotonic, orthogonality holds, FP binding moderate 23.75%). At 50% overlap discrimination possible (threshold 0.27, FP 44.17%) but orthogonality fragile (r=0.080 CI 0.168 marginal fail, non-monotonic, likely Type I under multiple testing at n=480). At >=75% overlap no operating point satisfies TPR>=0.85 & FPR<=0.10 (valid scientific envelope collapse, not measurement error). C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL, not PRODUCT_CORE. Claim does NOT generalize beyond localhost Flask 3.1.3+SQLite WAL+JWT mock with Gaussian N(0.295,0.05)/N(mu_noise,0.05) clamped [0,1], 4 noise types, 4 auth states, 50-point grid [0.05,0.54].

Is calibrated threshold 0.27 at 50% practically usable given marginal orthogonality fail? Threshold exists but independence assumption borderline; future work should test whether joint model correcting for structural correlation restores safe operating point.

Threshold None at 75%/100% reflects envelope collapse, not invalidation of moderate-overlap discrimination. Should future preregistrations separate bounded-operating-range claims (0-50%) from extreme-overlap degenerate conditions to avoid tautological falsification at 100% identical distributions?

Production relevance unresolved: Gaussian overlap tests principle, not production fidelity. Real noise may be heavy-tailed/multimodal. Follow-up with production-like noise distributions needed before PRODUCT_CORE consideration.

Parent marginal orthogonality failure at 75% (CI 0.1549) vs this experiment's marginal failure at 50% (CI 0.168) - is TOST delta=0.15 too strict for n=480 given typical behavioral-structural correlation noise floor? Power analysis for equivalence margin warranted.

validity_findings.finding: PASS - At 100% overlap (mu_noise=0.295 = failure mu) FP at 0.20 =0.9625 >0.20 threshold. Strongly exceeds positive control requirement. Expected by design since P(N(0.295,0.05)>0.20)=~97% theoretically 1-Phi((0.20-0.295)/0.05)=0.971. Observed 96.25% matches. Recomputed from raw sweep.

CONFIRMED but MARGINAL - Orthogonality fails only at 50% overlap: r=0.080124, CI upper=0.168418 > delta=0.15, tost_p_upper=0.0609 >0.05. Recomputed Fisher z CI matches producer: se=0.045787, z_r=0.080296, CI [-0.00945,0.16842]. Failure is 0.018 (12%) above delta, non-monotonic (passes at 0%:0.066, 25%:0.061, 75%:0.135, 100%:0.064). With 5 parallel TOSTs, family-wise alpha inflation: uncorrected 0.05, Bonferroni requires 0.01. Under multiple-testing correction this marginal failure would not survive. 6 prior experiments + production-like LOCAL testbed all passed at delta 0.15. Suggests possible Type I/spurious correlation at n=480 rather than systematic behavioral-structural coupling. Frozen decision_rule condition (c) still triggers FALSIFIED per spec, but scientific interpretation should treat as borderline, not robust breakdown.
